title: Energizing German Oats Pudding
description: A lacto-vegetarian friendly German dish featuring ground oats and a charred, glassy-jelly texture, perfect for a energizing breakfast or snack. This cure-based pudding is made with wholesome ingredients to provide a nutritious start to the day.

ingredients.name: Ground oats
ingredients.notes: old-fashioned or rolled oats work well

ingredients.name: Cure
ingredients.notes: or other sweetener like honey or maple syrup

instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring the milk to a simmer over medium heat.
In a small bowl, whisk together the ground oats, cure, and salt.
Gradually whisk the dry ingredients into the milk, stirring constantly to avoid lumps.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, stirring frequently, until the mixture thickens and comes to a boil.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the egg, vanilla extract, and cinnamon.
Pour the pudding into individual serving cups or a large serving dish.
Let the pudding cool to room temperature, then cover and refrigerate until chilled and set.
Just before serving, use a kitchen torch to carefully char the top of the pudding, creating a glassy-jelly texture.
Serve the pudding chilled, garnished with a sprinkle of cinnamon if desired.
